scientific_integrity: Proof and exact rational finite reproducer are supplied. Finite checks are corroborative, not a proof of the unrestricted parameter range. No independent scientific assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real-Hilbert distortion for unweighted KG(n,3), n≥8. Minimum embedding dimension and full n=8 coordinate classification are not determined; possible older association-scheme priority is not independently excluded.
title: Exact Euclidean distortion and forced nonfaithfulness for three-subset Kneser graphs
